question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

When Sanathan asked Mr. Jignesh / for a fresh evaluation of his performance / in the last financial year, / little did him know that the results will come out worse than expected.

options.text: for a fresh evaluation of his performance
little did him know that the results will come out worse than expected

solution:
The correct answer is **option 4.**
